initialize: v.prev_p_3p_x = q.position(0); v.prev_p_3p_y = q.position(1); v.prev_p_3p_z = q.position(2);
v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward = 0; v.smooth_p_local_vel_right = 0; v.smooth_p_vel_up = 0; v.sway_forward = 0; v.sway_right = 0; v.sway_dir_angle = 0;
pre_animation: !q.is_in_ui && q.time_stamp > v.prev_time_stamp ? {v.p_v_3p_x = q.position(0) - v.prev_p_3p_x; v.prev_p_3p_x = q.position(0); v.p_v_3p_y = q.position(1) - v.prev_p_3p_y; v.prev_p_3p_y = q.position(1); v.p_v_3p_z = q.position(2) - v.prev_p_3p_z; v.prev_p_3p_z = q.position(2); v.p_v_3p_frame_alpha = 0;};

t.yaw_speed = math.clamp(c.is_first_person ? v.yaw_delta : q.yaw_speed * 0.05, -10, 10) * 0.05; v.smooth_yaw_speed = math.lerp(t.yaw_speed, v.smooth_yaw_speed, math.exp((-5 + 4 * math.abs(t.yaw_speed)) * q.delta_time));

t.pitch_coeff = -2 + math.sqrt(0.5 + math.clamp(v.smooth_pitch_speed * 0.4, -1, 1) * 0.5); v.smooth_pitch_speed = math.lerp(math.clamp(((v.pitch ?? v.player_x_rotation) - (v.prev_pitch ?? v.player_x_rotation)) * t.pitch_coeff * 0.3, -2, 1), v.smooth_pitch_speed, math.exp(-3 * q.delta_time));

t.local_p_vel_forward = math.cos(c.is_first_person ? v.yaw : q.body_y_rotation + q.target_y_rotation) * v.p_v_3p_z - math.sin(c.is_first_person ? v.yaw : q.body_y_rotation + q.target_y_rotation) * v.p_v_3p_x; v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward = math.lerp(t.local_p_vel_forward * 0.2 - math.clamp(-v.p_v_3p_y * 0.15, 0, 0.3), v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward, math.exp(-3 * q.delta_time));

t.local_p_vel_right = -math.cos(c.is_first_person ? v.yaw : q.body_y_rotation + q.target_y_rotation) * v.p_v_3p_x - math.sin(c.is_first_person ? v.yaw : q.body_y_rotation + q.target_y_rotation) * v.p_v_3p_z; v.smooth_p_local_vel_right = math.lerp(t.local_p_vel_right * 0.2, v.smooth_p_local_vel_right, math.exp(-3 * q.delta_time));

v.sway_forward = math.clamp(math.lerp(v.smooth_pitch_speed / (1 + v.smooth_yaw_speed * 0.5), v.smooth_pitch_speed / (1 + v.smooth_yaw_speed * 0.5) * 0.5 + v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward * 3, math.min(math.abs(v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward) * 40, 1)), -1, 1);

v.sway_right = math.clamp(math.lerp(v.smooth_yaw_speed / (1 + v.smooth_pitch_speed * 0.5 + math.abs(v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward) * 30), v.smooth_yaw_speed / (1 + v.smooth_pitch_speed * 0.5 + math.abs(v.smooth_p_local_vel_forward) * 30) * 0.5 + v.smooth_p_local_vel_right * 3, math.min(math.abs(v.smooth_p_local_vel_right) * 40, 1)), -1, 1);

t.sway_magn = math.sqrt(math.pow(v.sway_forward,2) + math.pow(v.sway_right,2)); v.sway_dir_angle = math.atan2(v.sway_right/(t.sway_magn + 0.0001), v.sway_forward/(t.sway_magn + 0.0001)) * math.clamp(t.sway_magn*5, 0, 1);
